questions.question: While a clicked period is being fetched, should the rest of Ask stay usable — i.e. can someone type a new question before the continuation comes back?
options: Lock the panel while it runs (Recommended)
Allow a new ask alongside it
questions.chosen: Lock the panel while it runs (Recommended)

questions.question: If a clicked period fails (server refuses it, or the network drops), what should the user be left looking at?
A clicked period can come back as something other than a data answer — for example another clarification, or an informational glossary reply. Which of those should take over the turn?
